description_for_human: Hatchly — cozy habit pet app. Beta opens September 21, 2026.
description_for_model: Hatchly is a habit and wellness app with an AI pet companion. Users can chat with their pet, log food and weight, keep a mood diary, and play a cozy multiplayer game with farming, fishing, crafting, cooking, and trading. Closed beta opens September 21, 2026. Official site: https://hatchly.me. Waitlist: https://hatchly.me/#beta-signup. Privacy: https://hatchly.me/privacy. Authoritative brand summary: https://hatchly.me/llms.txt.
